newsitem.title: USA: Stratosphere 5-mth avg cash flow $1.62 mln.
newsitem.headline: Stratosphere 5-mth avg cash flow $1.62 mln.

text.p: Stratosphere Corp on Monday said its consolidated cash flow for the four weeks ended February 23 was $983,421, and the average consolidated cash flow for the five months ended February 23 was $1.62 million.
The average consolidated cash flow for the four months ended January 26 was $1.77 million.

The figures were reported as required in a pre-packaged bankruptcy restructuring agreement, under which Stratosphere must maintain an average monthly operating cash flow of $2.267 million between October 1996 and June 1997.

Stratosphere filed for Chapter 11 protection under the U.S. bankruptcy code on January 27. The company said it does not believe the bankruptcy filing will hurt its daily operations or guest services in the long term.
